response.sql: WITH mt AS (SELECT t.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bpm FROM Track t GROUP BY t.MediaTypeId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_bpm FROM mt), kept AS (SELECT mt.avg_price, mt.bpm, o.avg_bpm FROM mt CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE mt.bpm > o.avg_bpm) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_prices, AVG(bpm) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, AVG(bpm - avg_bpm) AS avg_rate_above_overall FROM kept;
